name: Competitor Analysis
purpose: Analyze competitor interfaces, workflows, and ergonomics to identify opportunities.
inputs: Named competitors, versions and platforms, and scoped user workflows
Dated screenshots, recordings, public documentation, and pricing-page captures
Comparison rubric, target users, business constraints, and evidence-recency window
outputs: Step-level teardown matrix linking observations to dated evidence
Comparable heuristic and accessibility scores with inference labels
Ranked opportunity backlog with impact, cost, and validation plan
stop_conditions: Every finding has dated evidence and separates observation from inference
All scoped workflows use the same rubric and stale captures are excluded from ranking
Token budget exhausted or access constraints prevent compliant evidence capture
